summary: Read a list of non-negative integers. The length is between 1 and 1000, and every value is at most 10^5. A person starts on the leftmost cell. The value in the current cell is the farthest number of cells that person may leap forward, and a shorter leap is allowed. Write the smallest number of leaps needed to land on the rightmost cell. Reaching that cell is always possible, so the answer is a finite count.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is tokens in the same order as the method parameters.
